# Neo4j MCP

> A Model Context Protocol server that gives AI assistants structured access to a Neo4j graph database, including schema introspection and Cypher query execution.

Written in Python and installable from PyPI; configured as an MCP server in clients such as Claude, Cursor, or VS Code via mcp.json. Provides tools: get-schema, read-cypher, write-cypher (disabled with NEO4J_MCP_READ_ONLY=true), and list-gds-procedures. Official documentation, a Discord channel, and a contributing guide are available; issues go through GitHub.

## Docs

- [Neo4j MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neo4j/mcp/main/README.md): MCP server bridging AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and VS Code to Neo4j, with schema exploration and Cypher query tools.
- [Features](https://github.com/neo4j/mcp/blob/main/README.md#features): Schema exploration, natural-language Cypher queries, and inspection of nodes, relationships, and paths for analysis.
- [Tools](https://github.com/neo4j/mcp/blob/main/README.md#tools): Tools for schema introspection, read-only and write Cypher queries, and listing GDS procedures.
- [Links](https://github.com/neo4j/mcp/blob/main/README.md#links): Official documentation, Discord channel, contributing guide, and how to file GitHub issues with reproduction details.
- [TLS/HTTPS setup for Neo4j MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neo4j/mcp/main/docs/TLS_SETUP.md): Generating self-signed certificates and testing the MCP server over TLS during development, with client CA limitations.
